notes.title: Demo is paused until a0.8 on July 17th 2024, Playtests start on June 12th
notes.notes:
[b]DEMO IS PAUSED[/b]

Follow our Devlogs on:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rorx_official]Twitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/UtBk4bGUNA]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RiseoftheRobotsX]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/RoRx_Official]X[/url]
[/list] 

We are working hard to release the new and upgraded version of the game (a0.8). Thanks to everyone for the quality testing and feedbacks.

Release date for the [b][u]Playtests[/u][/b] / Alpha a0.8 version : June 12th, [u][b]Demo [/b][/u]will be released on July 17th.

What will change:
- 🎏 Factions system, select 1 faction to fight for and get access to an exclusive Robot family and other powerful bonuses
- 👶 Onboarding tutorial!
- 🏝️ Improved graphics by a lot
- 🧩 Revamped UI
- 🥇 Loads of new missions

notes.title: The Alpha of Rise of the Robots X is available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Mental, and valor young Strategist,

You asked for it, you got it! The Playtest for Rise of the Robots X is now available on Steam. All you have to do is click on "[b]Request Access[/b]" to be queued for the upcoming test sessions.

[b]Attention:[/b] The game servers [b]are not open 24/7[/b]. The availability schedule will evolve based on the game's population. It is available on our [url=https://discord.gg/UtBk4bGUNA]Discord[/url] and on the game's login page.

[b]January[/b]
Wednesdays 8 PM - 12 AM CET
Sundays 10 AM - 11 PM CET

[i]A tournament is being organized on Wednesday, January 17, details on our Discord.[/i]
